subject: Film & Cinema
title: Greta Gerwig: Indie to Blockbuster
description: A quick, practical guide to Greta Gerwig: Indie to Blockbuster.

hook.text: Gerwig went from mumblecore actor to directing a billion-dollar Barbie film in a decade.

buildup.text: Lady Bird and Little Women established her as a master of warm, character-driven storytelling.

discovery.text: She makes personal films feel universal — every audience member sees themselves in her characters.

twist.text: Barbie proved she could embed sharp commentary inside the biggest commercial framework.

climax.text: Gerwig's career arc shows that indie sensibility and mainstream scale aren't enemies.

punchline.text: She made a toy movie into a cultural event.

quiz.question: What was Greta Gerwig's acting background?
